claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised free concerts every evening at 619 Market street, St. Louis, with only the best singers engaged.
claims.excerpt: retired champion pugilist o: the world, 619 Market street. Free concer every evening.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was billed in this advertisement as the retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt: retired champion pugilist o: the world, 619 Market street.

notes: The text does not call 619 Market street a saloon, so the hint's word 'saloon' is not used. The other item on the page (Freiboth swindle) does not involve Allen.
